source.note: AC1-AC4 each have a named proof path. [...] AC5 has no proof path. Design item 4 specifies relayDenyReason and its branches, but no test is named for the reason text. There is no case for: a live seat for the item that the hook did not bind (must not say 'mutating the tree without a performing story'); an allocated binding once the seat has resolved (must not say 'allocated to agent=executor'); and a wrong binding or stale seat (must name the relay rule). The command-level test asserts deny or no deny, not the message. The claim that unmarked sessions keep editPermissionDenyReason/editGateDenyReason byte-for-byte also has no regression assertion. Add a table test, e.g. TestRelayDenyReason, over relayDenyReason (and the gate/commitgate reason path). It should assert the text for each branch: seat not bound but a live seat exists (names both session ids; no 'without a performing story' text), no live seat or a stale seat (relay rule), in flight, binding not allocated (relay rule; no 'agent=executor' text), and item mismatch. It should also assert that an unmarked session's reason is unchanged.
